podcast.title: Business Partner of Lieber & Stoller
podcast.body: Lester Sill partnered with Jerry Lieber and Mike Stoller in several business ventures throughout their careers. "Had partnered with them in several business ventures."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Introduced Phil Spector to Lieber & Stoller
podcast.body: Lester Sill played a crucial role in Phil Spector's career by calling Lieber and Stoller to inform them about Spector, a talented young musician who had already achieved a hit with "To Know Him Is To Love Him" with his group The Teddy Bears, and was eager to learn from the renowned songwriting and production team. "Lester Sill... phoned them up out of the blue one day, and told them about a kid he knew who'd had a big hit with a song called To Know Him Is To Love Him, which he'd written for his group The Teddy Bears."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Lieber & Stoller's Early Mentor
podcast.body: Lester Sill served as Jerry Lieber and Mike Stoller's mentor during their early years in the music business. "Lester Sill, who had been Leibor and Stuller's mentor in their early years."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: The Coasters' Manager
podcast.body: At the time of Phil Spector's introduction to Lieber and Stoller, Lester Sill was managing The Coasters. "And was currently the coasters manager."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
